special_situations.headline: Newspaper publication of commencement of the pre-packaged insolvency resolution process.
special_situations.summary: Newspaper notice confirms commencement of pre-pack insolvency process (PPIRP).
special_situations.impact: Not a monetary trigger; qualitative distress signal. FY26 revenue rose 48% to ₹126.58 Cr but net profit collapsed 91% to ₹0.20 Cr.
special_situations.risk: NCLT approval pending; amalgamation with Onix Renewable adds execution uncertainty.
special_situations.view_reasoning: Formal insolvency process underway alongside sharp profit collapse despite revenue growth signals real distress.

special_situations.headline: Resignation of Statutory Auditor - M/S R.B. Jain & Associates
special_situations.summary: Statutory auditor R.B. Jain & Associates resigns shortly after 5-year appointment.
special_situations.impact: No deal figure; qualitative governance concern given the firm was only appointed in May 2026 for a five-year term.
special_situations.risk: Rapid auditor turnover soon after CIRP exit raises financial-reporting credibility questions.
special_situations.view_reasoning: Auditor exiting within months of a 5-year appointment at a recently-CIRP-exited company is an unusual red flag.

special_situations.subcategory: Award of Order / Receipt of Order
special_situations.headline: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Receipt of Letter of Award
special_situations.summary: Won 230 MW under SECI's 1 GW FDRE round-the-clock tender at ₹5.26/unit.
special_situations.impact: Adds ~3% to its 7,910 MW portfolio; backed by 25-year PPA with SECI, though exact capex/order value not disclosed.
special_situations.risk: 86% revenue concentration in two off-takers (GUVNL, MSEDCL); debt-to-equity of 3.77x.
special_situations.view_reasoning: Genuine capacity win for a large, fast-growing IPP, but high leverage and thin ~1% RoNW temper enthusiasm post-IPO.

special_situations.subcategory: Award of Order / Receipt of Order
special_situations.headline: We are pleased to inform you that the Company has been Awarded the Letter of award from the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) at Madangundi Fee Plaza.
special_situations.summary: Won NHAI toll-collection LOA worth ₹28.47 Cr at Madangundi Fee Plaza, Jharkhand.
special_situations.impact: ~4.9% of FY26 revenue (₹28.47 Cr vs ₹579.58 Cr FY26 revenue), one-year recurring contract.
special_situations.risk: Negative operating cash flows and declining FY26 revenue despite steady order wins.
special_situations.view_reasoning: Adds revenue visibility via recurring toll contracts, but persistent negative cash flow undercuts the positive.

special_situations.headline: Revised intimation of receipt of letter of award
Full and Final Settlement w.r.t. Insolvency petition filed against Sherisha Solar LLP and completion of internal restructuring.

fallen_ipos.view_reasoning: Debut fall coincided with a broad market crash, but tiny Rs3.4cr Q4 profit and continued downtrend since suggest weak fundamentals too.
Q4 profit fell 37% QoQ and multiple large shareholders (L7 Hitech, QE Securities, Kunvarji) sold heavily post-listing, pressuring price.
Fell mainly on weak IPO-market sentiment, not company issues; FY26 revenue/profit grew strongly, but too new to confirm trend.
